description: Creates a document, then deletes it by id (`DELETE /api/documents/{id}`).

title: Upload a new version of a document
description: Creates a document, uploads a new file and adds it as the document's new version (`POST /api/documents/{id}/versions`); the signing flow is reset. Caveat: this file is not listed in `Console.csproj`, so it is not compiled; add it to the project before selecting it in `Program.cs`.

title: Upload a new version of a document
description: Creates a document, uploads a new file and adds it as the document's new version (`POST /api/documents/{id}/versions`); the signing flow is reset. Caveat: it uses the shared `CreateDocument()` helper, whose Windows-style relative path only resolves on Windows from `nodejs/scenarios` (see `run.command`), and `scenario.ts` names a `bigSample.pdf` that is not in the repository, so recompiling `dist` breaks it. Caveat: a participant's e-mail is misspelled `@mailnator.com`, which is not Mailinator; fix it before running.

description: Searches the organization's folders by name, takes the first match, and creates the document with its `folderId`. It fails when no folder matches, so create the folder first. Searches for "Sample Folder".
